recentItems.title: What a Comeback! Stephen Gogolev Skates to "Piano Concerto No. 2" by Rachmaninov 🇨🇦🎶 | Music Monday
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live all the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch 

Stephen Gogolev secured a double fifth-place finish for Canada at Milano Cortina 2026, finishing fifth with Team Canada in the team competition and fifth again in the men’s singles. Gogolev first shot to fame as a child prodigy, landing triple Axels and quad Salchows at just 10 years old. But a teenage growth spurt slowed his rapid rise, while back problems added another hurdle. Stress fractures in his lower lumbar spine forced him to miss training and withdraw from multiple competitions. His return to the Olympic stage, and the pair of fifth-place finishes, made his comeback all the more remarkable.

Relive the best moments from the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games, featuring elite athletes, thrilling competition, and unforgettable highlights across the world’s top winter sports on the Olympic stage.
